description.text: Rocket Gang Half Deck W -black-, released on 15 October 2004 alongside the Rocket Gang Strikes Back expansion: two ready-built 30-card half decks of Team Rocket's Pokémon and Dark Pokémon, among them Dark Tyranitar and Rocket's Moltres ex, with Pokémon of the Sevii Islands, where much of Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen is set. The two decks can be played against each other or combined into one 60-card deck; a coin and a rule book came with them.
